title: Party seated (trigger)
description: The event that starts the dine-in process: a seated party, ready to order. It carries only what is known at seating — no food order (that comes from the diner's Select-items HITL task) and no tender (captured later at the payment step). Published by the stub generator (or any upstream) and matched by the pack's triage rule on order_type. Author this schema in the wizard — it is the process trigger, not a tool output, so it cannot be introspected from the MCP server.

ticket_id.description: Unique id for this seated party's check.

dietary_flags.description: Party-level allergens/diets flagged at seating, e.g. ["nuts"] — screen_allergens reads these.
